data.text: 7/10 同事表示預計八月才比較有空處理HTML，pending

- The Emiton Empire was actually ruling more than the island, so the island defeating the Emitons to enter Dranison Empire is actually simply an independence campaign
- The island was small enough that the Emiton doesn’t fucking care
- The Emiton Empire developed well across the sea, with technology and modernization non-stop, is now an unstoppable force
- Many ancient religion was origin from across the sea, and spread to the island, for example, Laxthos (Kashla was actually from across the sea)

- Revived the 3-kingdoms
  - Favored the Humans, but also control them the most
  - Divided the Elves and see them as betrayers
  - Isolated the Dwarves, also to stop technology to rebuild
- Burnt down libraries and destroy technologies, to control people with fear and basic needs
  - The elves love nature more, so they don't really care
  - The humans were "taught" that techs were evil beings, and so technologies were destroyed
  - The dwarves preserve their tech knowledge, and ask for a high price if needed
- The rise of more noble families, which also acts as a hierarchical meaning
- Seeking individual's glory - adventurers increasing!
- Secretly suppressing other religion than Laxthos
  - Removing statues
  - Make religions use symbols instead of figures
- Magic become less flourishing
- Techs lost, nowhere to rebuild
- Emperors hope to live as long as the elves, so they seek dark magic (Laxthos)

- Dubbed as the Lothum Empire
- Canceled the 3-kingdoms
- Hedonism, music
- Raw natural magic rising
- "Companions" other than "pets"
- Major catastrophic events, seen as "the elves doesn't deserve to rule"

- High technology rising (Thanks, dwarves!), with robots, machines, and more in late Trinix
- The rise of multiple modern religions, church
  - Religious magic flourish
  - Statues rises
- Theatres and arts flourish
- From diversity to racism against other species, which led to its downfall
- Corruption

- Defeated the last empire, the Emiton empire
  - The Emiton empire actually ruled more than the island, and only lose the island to Dranison -- it's basically an independence campaign
  - The island was seemed less and was not cared much by Emiton
- Divided the empire into the 3 kingdoms
- Started using the current PP, GP, SP, CP coin system
- Starting using the "common" language (the Dranisian卓尼西亞文), which was an dialect in the island for a long time, and not only used by human
- Schools, libraries
- The Great Citadel
- Basic science, medicine
- Hierarchy
6/29 請會寫HTML的強者同事幫我優化介面，但因為是麻煩別人，不好意思跟他拉時間XD
7/9 補上支線Mysltan Colossus中崔尼斯的弟弟邁爾斯坦的設定，置於雲端硬碟資料夾內
7/9 補上Plus團跑到的拉索斯教起源故事設定，置於雲端硬碟資料夾內

- 有了內建檔案搜尋功能，您就可從 Google 雲端硬碟將資料夾和檔案附加到任何 Trello 版本的 Trello 卡片上。
- 查看附加到卡片上的任何 Google雲端硬碟檔案或資料夾，掌握其即時資訊和預覽。

listing.name: GoodGantt
listing.description:
GoodGantt allows you to build gantt charts based on your Trello cards. 

### All boards in one place

![Boards_load](https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/gx5d4183qzg35gk/projects-load.gif)

You can work on several boards at once in one window. Enable or disable the boards you need to display.

### Realtime work

Work as a team and track changes in real time.

### Tasks grouping

![Grouping](https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/i9ch7h8rzdqvkfo/group%20by%20dragging.gif)

Group tasks and build any hierarchy. Keep track of the progress of the exercise throughout the group.

### Milestones

Mark milestones on the timeline

### Automatic cards placement

![Table_settings](https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/9pp2xun5v97uagt/kts%20default.gif)

Cards created through Gantt will be placed in the list that you specify in the project settings.

### Workload panel

![Workload_opening](https://goodgantt.com/external-sources/Workload-panel-Opening.gif)

Watch for the load of your team members and evenly distribute the load between them using the access panel. Choose between the number of tasks and the number of working hours per day.

###Gantt Chart Export

You can export a gantt chart on the Professional plan in the following types:

- PNG
- PDF
- Excel
- MS Project
- iCal/Google calendar/Outlook

### [SOON] Dependences

Build dependence between tasks. Any changes in terms will shift related tasks.

### [SOON] Tasks progress

Make subjective progress on the task in order to understand at what stage the readiness is.

### [SOON] Connect your time trackers

Connect your favorite time trackers and track your employees' performance right on the Gantt chart. Tracked time is displayed as a green bar in the task line.

listing.name: Gantt chart (by Placker)
listing.description:
# **Clear schedule view of your Trello boards with a Gantt chart**

Are you looking for a way to manage your schedules while continuing to use Trello as your main work management platform?

You just found it. With the Gantt Power-Up, you will be able to visualize your Trello card and checklist item dates in a flexible timeline, set dependencies and manage your team's workload.

## **✅ How a Gantt chart is going to help you**

Placker turns your Trello boards into professional looking Gantt charts that can be used in any situation. These are a few examples:

✔ Show your team when each task will start and end

✔ Identify critical tasks, preventing delays

✔ Get insight on activities and dates, deciding the best approach upfront

✔ Send a document to your stakeholders where they can see project estimates

✔ Present the project timeline in a meeting to keep everyone on the same page

## **📅 Visualize one or multiple Trello boards in a timeline that can be tailored to your project needs**

![desc\_gantt\_single\_multiple\_boards.gif](https://trello.placker.com/power-up-gantt/current/img/desc_gantt_single_multiple_boards.gif)

## **🔗 Connect cards with dependencies, understanding the impact that one card has in the other tasks and milestones**

![desc\_gantt\_dependencies.gif](https://trello.placker.com/power-up-gantt/current/img/desc_gantt_dependencies.gif)

## **📊 Manage workloads and see how many hours of effort are assigned to each member with a resource planner**

![desc\_gantt\_resource\_planning.gif](https://trello.placker.com/power-up-gantt/current/img/desc_gantt_resource_planning.gif)

## **💻 Is it similar to Microsoft Project?**

Many of our customers were using MS Project, but needed a solution like Trello + Placker for more flexibility and integrating with a platform they were used to.

Were your project plans made with Project or Excel? Don’t worry: it’s possible to import these files so that you don’t spend time remaking them. Also, we have the MS [Planner](https://trello.com/power-ups/60ed7adfbb9c48569fa1b446/enable "‌") & Trello Sync Power-Up where you can connect Trello and Planner in real time.

## **👉 Easy to get started**

To make the most of your Gantt chart, simply follow the steps below:

1. Enable the Power-Up in one of your boards
2. Click the “Placker - Import” button at the top to sync with Placker
3. Click the “Gantt” button that will show up at the top
4. Optional: edit dates and dependencies (it will be synced in real time with Trello)
5. Export the chart so you can send it to your team

## **🧭 You also get access to more planning and tracking tools**

The Placker platform offers a variety of features to help you manage your projects. When you sign up, in addition to creating Gantt charts, you will be able to use the same data to generate reports, mirror cards and import/export data from the boards.

The Power-Up is **free for 15 days**, and after that you can start a subscription to continue having access to all of these features. See the available plans at: [placker.com/pricing](http://placker.com/pricing "‌")

## **💬 Need help? We are here for you**

If you could use some assistance in setting up your Gantt charts or have any questions, please let us know at: [support@placker.com](mailto:support@placker.com "‌")
listing.overview: Gantt chart, Resource Planning and extended timeline view. All-in-one project management for Trello by Placker
